annotations.title: Retailers with a verified price-match policy

description: Returns the retailers whose price-match policy a person has verified, optionally filtered by category and country, each with its terms and policy page. A retailer absent from the list is unverified, not a no.

category.description: Registry category, e.g. electronics, furniture, outdoor, hardware, sports, jewellery, beauty. Optional.

country.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code, e.g. AU. Optional.

name: retailers_that_price_match
